sloka: अशक्यः सहसा राजन् भावो वेत्तुम् परस्य वै ।अन्तः स्वभावैर् गीतैस् तैर् नैपुण्यम् पश्यता भृशम् ॥६-१७-६१॥।।
transliteration: aśakyaḥ sahasā rājan bhāvo vettum parasya vai ।antaḥ svabhāvair gītais tair naipuṇyam paśyatā bhṛśam ॥6-17-61॥।।

translations.english: "O king It is not possible to know the intention (of an enemy) of others at once without excessive dexterity. It is to be known by his tone of words and description."
